entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, just get someone on the line. This is ridiculous.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return this useless VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Peterson. Order number is VF778-012. And don't waste my time.
Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th, which was 22 days ago.
And? So what? Are you going to process the return or not?

Well, sir, for items that are worn on the body, our return **policy** is typically much shorter due to **hygiene** and **sanitation** concerns. At 22 days, I'm afraid it is **too late** to start a return for this kind of product.

Are you kidding me?! That is absolute garbage! I read the policy on your website when I bought it! It said 90 days! I want to speak to your manager right now! This is a scam and I'll be posting reviews everywhere telling people VeloFit doesn't honor its own policies!

I understand your frustration, sir, and I apologize for the confusion. Please allow me to put you on a brief hold while I review the specific documentation for your item. I want to make sure I'm giving you the correct information.
You'd better. This is completely unacceptable.

Thank you for holding, Mark. I've reviewed the official return knowledge base for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, and you are absolutely correct. My sincere apologies. That item does fall under our standard 90-day return **policy**. The stricter rules apply to some of our other biometric devices, and I misspoke.
You are well within the timeframe, so I can process this return for a full refund for you immediately. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file.
About time. So that's it? I just mail it back?

Yes, just print the label, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Fine. Make sure it happens.
It will be taken care of. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
